Here’s a quick snapshot of some of the most recognizable names who have worn the Los Angeles Clippers jersey over the years—both past legends and recent stars:

| Era | Notable Players | Notes |
|-----|-----------------|-------|
| **Early Years (1970s‑80s)** | *Kenny Smith*, *Moses Malone* (brief stint), *Bill Walton* (short tenure) | The franchise was still finding its footing in San Diego/LA. |
| **1990s** | *Chris Webber* (drafted 1993), *Julius Erving* (short stint), *Gary Payton* (1998–2000) | The team began building a competitive core. |
| **Late 90s – Early 2000s** | *Chris Paul* (1999–2007), *Blake Griffin* (2009–2015), *DeAndre Jordan* (2009–2018) | This period saw the emergence of future All-Stars. |
| **Mid‑2000s** | *Paul Pierce* (2005–2006), *Steve Nash* (2006–2007) | Short but high‑profile stints. |
| **2010s** | *Kawhi Leonard* (2011–2019), *Paul George* (2013–2019), *Reggie Jackson* (2015–2021) | The “Lob City” era; the Clippers became a perennial playoff contender. |
| **Recent Years (2020‑present)** | *Paul George* (2021‑present), *Kawhi Leonard* (2021‑present), *Reggie Jackson* (2021‑present), *Bam Adebayo* (2021‑present), *Jamal Murray* (2021‑present) | Current roster includes multiple All‑Star talents. |

### How to Find More Details

If you’re interested in a deeper dive—such as career stats, exact seasons played, or game logs—you can look up each player individually on sites like Basketball‑Reference.com or the official NBA website. For example, searching “Paul George Clippers stats” will pull up his full career numbers and highlight his time with LA.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like a more exhaustive list, or if you’re curious about a particular decade or player!
